title: MindEval2: Clinically Grounded Patients and Rubrics for Evaluating Language Models in Mental Health Support
snippet: We evaluate 18 proprietary and open-weight models on MindEval2, finding that while frontier models have largely improved on issues related to surface level quality and boundaries, guidance calibration remains the dominant failure mode across all models, accounting for most of the quality gap.

title: Grid-Bench: Can LLMs Predict How Discrete Worlds Change?
